name: Aisling and the Tavern of Elves
source:
“Aisling and the Tavern of Elves” is an Isekai Fantasy-Comedy Dating Sim Visual Novel, where you play as Aisling Whitehorse, a hapless mercenary turned tavern owner eking out a living in the Elven Kingdom of Eiredagh.


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444360/Aisling_and_the_Tavern_of_Elves/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《艾斯林与精灵酒馆》是一款异世界奇幻喜剧约会模拟视觉小说，你将扮演艾斯林·怀特霍斯，一个倒霉的雇佣兵，后来成为酒馆老板，在艾尔达精灵王国勉强维持生计。


[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444360/Aisling_and_the_Tavern_of_Elves/]Steam[/url]]
